description: Committed three-antenna holography pointing fixture. One reference antenna stays on axis. Antenna 1 samples a 3x3 Memo 195 dense grid at 1.72 arcmin. Antenna 2 samples a 2x2 sparse grid at 4.59 arcmin. One dense sample is missing and one sparse sample is an unsettled slew. The table preserves DIRECTION, TARGET, and POINTING_OFFSET.
